timeline.summary: Sasken Technologies Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Paawan Bhargava**, scheduled a meeting on May 8, 2026, to review audited financials and propose final dividend for FY2025-26.
Sasken Technologies Limited’s Board, chaired by Rajiv C Mody, recommended a final dividend of ₹13 per equity share (₹10 each) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Promoter **Rajiv C. Mody** declared no encumbrances by Promoter Group or Persons in Concert for FY2026 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
On October 26, 2026, Sasken Technologies announced its earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results to be held on October 29, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹320.95 Cr (+25.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹24.52 Cr (+151.5% YoY).
Sasken Technologies Limited conducted an earnings call on 29 October 2026, audio/video recorded and hosted at https://www.sasken.com/investors/quarterly-results.
